a4MicroSystemWeight.initializeScale: Initializes the I2C weighing module and records the empty scale value.
a4MicroSystemWeight.tareScale: Sets the current load on the scale to zero.
a4MicroSystemWeight.massGrams: Reads the measured mass in grams.
a4MicroSystemWeight.scaleConnected: Returns true when valid data can be read from the weighing module.
a4MicroSystemWeight.startCalibration: Records the empty scale value and starts a two-step calibration.
a4MicroSystemWeight.finishCalibration: Completes calibration using a known reference mass. Returns true when a valid calibration factor has been calculated.
a4MicroSystemWeight.finishCalibration|pa: mass of the calibration weight in grams
a4MicroSystemWeight.initializeKeypad: Initializes the 4x4 keypad. The micro:bit LED matrix is disabled because P3 is used by the keypad.
a4MicroSystemWeight.pressedKey: Reads the key currently pressed. Returns an empty string when no key is pressed.
a4MicroSystemWeight.waitForKey: Waits for one keypad key press and returns the key after it is released.
a4MicroSystemWeight.keyIsPressed: Returns true when the selected keypad key is currently pressed.
a4MicroSystemWeight.setCalibrationFactor: Sets the software calibration factor used to convert raw values into grams.
a4MicroSystemWeight.getCalibrationFactor: Returns the calibration factor currently used by the scale.
a4MicroSystemWeight.rawAverage: Reads the average raw value from the weighing module.
